text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis, having sprinted through her 
first 
three years in the Twinkle Series. She is 
now—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the new students are pouring out in 
droves... 
Has their first class already ended?

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Phalaeno-saaan! 
I-I... I...!

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: I got into Tracen Academy...!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —It suits you well.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
...*sniff*. Uwaaah... 
I'm so glad I worked hard, I really am...!

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
This is all thanks to you, Phalaeno-san! 
I watched you lead the way, and... and...!

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Driven solely by the desire to catch up to 
you... 
Uuu... I was able to make it all the way 
here...!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I see, I see...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Congratulations. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Phalaeno-saaann...!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A spontaneous warmth filled my chest. 
Another horse girl 
from the Club had stepped up to the 
threshold of her dreams.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This was the very result that lay 
at the end of the hoofprints Phalaenopsis 
had carved.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind her, as she raced along the Tiara 
path, 
the flame of the next generation had truly 
been kindled.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Going forward, many more girls will surely 
follow in 
Phalaenopsis's footsteps and enroll in 
Tracen Academy. 
And eventually—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the myriad achievements they bring 
home, 
—the Club will overflow.
choice_data_list:
And the one who brought about that future 
is—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
............Heh. 
It has finally sunk in.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...That I was truly able to pave the way 
to the future.
choice_data_list:
That's right. You paved it with your very 
way of life.

That's right. You paved it with your very 
way of life.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Quite so.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
However, Trainer—surely you have not 
decided 
that this is to be our final destination?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
There is still a future we must bring to 
pass.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now, shall we depart? 
Toward our next battlefield.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis & Club Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaahhh!!! 
Haaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come, you are drifting wide again! Lean 
more to the inside— 
...Yes! Keep that in mind at all times!

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, ma'am! Haaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come on, bite down and stay on me! 
The throat you are meant to tear out is 
right here!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Pheeew.
choice_data_list: Fired up as always, I see!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Her debut is fast approaching, you 
see. 
It is only natural that my guidance grows 
passionate.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And she is not alone. Many more juniors 
now run the front lines, 
harboring the grand ambition of turning 
our club into a beautiful garden.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
On turf, on dirt... each making full use 
of their strengths, 
bringing back the fruits of victory to our 
garden.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Do you see, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: The next future has already begun.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Beyond the turf I raced across lay this 
very sight. 
If so—then I must dedicate my heart and 
soul to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but worry a little. Even 
with one 
goal accomplished, she was still— 
pouring her burning soul into coaching the 
juniors.
choice_data_list:
...Are you sure you don't need to slow 
down your pace?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This was a milestone, a chance to pause. 
As the Trainer who had supported her, I 
suggested 
that she might want to take a breather.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Indeed, there is merit to that 
perspective. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I cannot allow it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It does not end with forging the club's 
future. 
Nor does it end with merely watching it 
unfold.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
In the next future as well—as a proud 
bloom of the past. 
I wish to remain engaged at the very front 
lines.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: With the club that I love.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Therefore... you understand, do you not, 
Trainer? 
The words you should offer me are not born 
of concern.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Rather, I want those hands to push me 
forward. 
Against my back.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: May I ask this of you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once more, I give Phalaenopsis the words 
she desires. 
And unexpectedly—they were my own desires 
as well.
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to a future where you 
lead our juniors to victory!

I'm looking forward to a future where you 
lead our juniors to victory!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —I shall answer that call.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, spring arrived 
at Phalaenopsis's club.
Hey there, Lady Phalaeno!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Were you watching that tandem run just 
now? 
...They're quite something, aren't they! 
Even those fresh recruits your club takes 
such pride in!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
As a senior here at Tracen Academy, 
I only meant to drop by and see how things 
were going— 
but what an unexpected harvest this turned 
out to be!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Hearing our young shoots praised so 
highly 
makes me proud indeed.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—They will all flourish, in due time. 
For our club is a place worthy of making 
that happen.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, indeed. Unlike Tracen Academy, 
it is brimming with delicate, thoughtful 
touches.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: —Heh, how intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A new encounter, a new future. 
The baton she carried connects to the next 
generation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—This is merely a step along the path to 
glorious triumph. 
Just the first page inscribed toward a 
future where 
this Club becomes a 'beautiful garden'...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, even so. Had that single flower not 
bloomed— 
that future would have never begun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The glory, prestige, and triumphs that 
will follow... 
All of them shall spring from the seeds 
she sowed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the Club will attain more 
splendor 
than any single book could ever record— 
ten years, twenty years, and far into the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It all began with a single blossom. 
With one solitary horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name was Phalaenopsis. 
And she bloomed in full glory within that 
beautiful garden—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The most exquisite moth orchid in all the 
world.
